title: Flash Motion: neon-violet glassmorphism SaaS agency promo
summary: A 30 s promo for a SaaS motion-design studio, fully in dark violet: frosted-glass panels with neon purple edge light, glowing orbit rings, a perspective neon grid tunnel, glass 3D cube, glass UI cards (dashboard, chart, avatar row, call card with waveform) and a teal glass shield. Short white two-to-three-line statements ('You built something special', 'Make it understood', 'Explain complex ideas', 'Show how it works') sit left of or inside the glass objects; ends on logo + 'Make your product clear'.
fit_reason: Premium-feeling and SaaS-native (glass UI cards, charts, short benefit lines), but the neon-violet glow is a generic AI/tech aesthetic and heavier than SaaSSuite's plain voice.

palette.mood: dark premium neon: deep violet-black with purple edge glows, one teal section

typography.size_behaviour: medium-large 2-3 line stacks (~6-8% height), left-aligned beside objects or centred inside rings/panels
typography.notes: Lines short (2-3 words each). Text sometimes sits behind glass so it is refracted/blurred.

text_animation: light sweep / shimmer gradient across text on hold
text slides with the glass panel in 3D (attached to surface)
motion blur smear when panel rotates away
motion: neon orbit ring traces around text
perspective grid tunnel with light streaks rushing by
glass cube with selection handles + cursor (design tool reference)
UI cards slide in a row (horizontal carousel)
audio waveform animates in call card
transitions: hard cut on beat between sections
graphic_elements: frosted glass panels with neon rim light
glass UI cards (avatars, toggle, chart, call card)
ui_treatment: rebuilt simplified UI as thick glassmorphism 3D cards with purple glow
signature_moves: thick frosted-glass UI cards with neon violet rim light
neon orbit ring framing a two-line statement
perspective grid tunnel with light streaks
short 2-3 word line stacks beside glass objects

best_segments.what: 'Make it understood' inside a glowing orbit ring, then glass dashboard 'Demos that connect'
'Explain complex ideas' chart card then 'Show how it works' avatar/toggle glass card slide

recreate.how: Glass 3D look is easiest via AI image/video (Higgsfield) or Three.js/Spline with transmission material; flat approximation in HTML with backdrop-filter, inset box-shadow glow, gradient borders, CSS perspective.
recreate.prompt: Dark violet-black 3D scene with thick frosted glass UI cards lit by neon purple rim light, glowing orbit rings, a perspective neon grid tunnel, short white two-line benefit statements beside the glass objects, slow camera fly-through.
